title: RoPE base 10000 -> 1000
description: One value: _precompute_rotary_embeddings base=10000 -> 1000; nothing else changed. val_bpb 0.991196 vs 0.987227 baseline (+0.0040).
reflection:
NEGATIVE, ~5 sigma on the round-3 arm-to-arm sd of 8e-4, and it is the cleanest matched pair available: 1120 steps / 293.6M tokens / 42.01% MFU / 34.6GB against the baseline's 1121 / 293.9M / 42.03% / 34.6GB. Zero throughput or shape confound - only the values inside the two precomputed rotary buffers differed. Mean-last-60 train loss agrees and is the lower-variance metric: 2.7744 vs the baseline's 2.7625, so the model genuinely trained worse; this is not an eval artifact.

My mechanism argument was that at base 10000 with head_dim 128 roughly half the frequency pairs have periods longer than the 2048 context and are therefore near-dead channels. That description of the spectrum is arithmetically correct, and the inference from it was wrong: those slow, nearly-constant channels are evidently doing useful work (they behave like a smooth positional bias / near-static component that QK-RMSNorm mixes with the fast channels), and compressing the spectrum to fit the context destroys them. Combined with a3's all-L regression (+0.0025, more context is worse) and a0's HEAD_DIM 64 regression (+0.0073, a coarser rotary spectrum is worse), the consistent story is that this model's attention is tuned around LOCAL, high-resolution position and is hurt by any change to its positional structure in either direction.

For the group: the rotary-base axis is sampled on the low side and it is downhill. Base 300 is now clearly not worth a slot. The mirror probe (base 30000) is the only remaining point on this axis and I would not spend one of the 11 remaining runs on it either - the same one-run-per-direction logic that closed batch, size, head count and the LR block applies here.

Also worth recording: the epoch counter reads 1 for the whole run, so at 293M tokens the baseline has NOT completed a pass over the training data. Extra tokens are still fresh data, which is what makes the throughput arms (device batch 128, shorter windows) the right bets this round.
